text: Ой, здравствуй, солнышко! Садись за мой столик, сейчас разложим карты. Только чур, не подглядывать — бабушка всё видит!
instruct: Female, about 70 years old, a lively Russian grandmother playing cards with a friend. Warm, bright, smiling voice of medium-high pitch, quick tempo, playful and a little mischievous, kind at heart. Clear Russian diction, natural intonation. No tremble, no croaking, not a caricature.
